{{Quote|Control is internal. It is the Jedi's ability to recognize the Force in himself and to use it to his benefit.|[[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Bodo Baas]]|<ref name="Jedi vs. Sith">[[Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force (real-life book)|''Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force'']]</ref>}}
'''Control''' was an aspect of [[Force power/Legends|Force powers]] in the teachings of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]. [[Jedi Initiate/Legends|Jedi Initiates]] began their studies with Control, opening their minds to [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] through abilities centered on the Initiate's own body and self. Development of these skills would continue throughout a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi's]] life and serve as the foundation for subsequent disciplines.<ref name="The Jedi Path">[[The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force (real-life book)|''The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force'']]</ref>

The discipline of Control was centered around three main abilities: ''[[tutaminis]]'' (energy absorption), ''[[curato salva]]'' (healing one's own self), and ''[[altus sopor]]'' (increasing one's focus on the Force).<ref name="The Jedi Path" />
